newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 7-yr bond average coupon at 6.586 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 7-yr bond average coupon at 6.586 pct.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia said it accepted bids at an average coupon of 6.586 percent at its auction of a seven-year Malaysian government bond for a total issue worth two billion ringgit.
It said the bids accepted were in a range of 6.60 to 6.56 percent.
They said Malaysian financial institutions applied for 8.33 billion ringgit against the offer.
Dealers said the bids accepted were in the range expected by the market.
The Malaysian Government Securities, as the bonds are called, are issued by Bank Negara on behalf of the Government.
The number of MGS issues has fallen over the last few years as the government has privatised most state-owned companies and infrastructure projects.
The central bank issued one five-year bond for two billion ringgit in June this year.
